description: This Java class 'ThingModifySignalMapper' maps 'ThingModifyCommand' objects to protocol signals by providing methods to generate topic paths and enhance payloads with entity data.

classes.name: ThingModifySignalMapper
classes.description: A final class responsible for mapping 'ThingModifyCommand' objects to protocol signals, extending 'AbstractModifySignalMapper' with specific implementations for topic path creation and payload enhancement.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Generates a TopicPathBuilder for a specific 'ThingModifyCommand', establishing the topic hierarchy for the signal.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Adds the entity's value to the payload if present, enhancing the message payload with entity data.
